label: monad-mainnet
_notes: The standing challenge (contracts/src/challenge/LatencyChallenge.sol), deployed by contracts/script/DeployChallenge.s.sol after the causal cutover.

Two instances with the same terms: one on Unison's causal WMON/AUSD (market 1), one on the old-rule control (market 2). Fills on both are marked to MON/USD over AUSD/USD through the causal reference's market 1 feeds.
Latency profit: every fill in the window, each marked to the first Chainlink observation at least horizonSec after its order, averaging more than epsilonBps after fees over at least minFills fills.
The window runs from deployment to the end of judging (27 October 2026, 23:59:59 UTC); an unclaimed pot returns to the sponsor three days later.

team: accounts that can't enter (the venue's own keys, the owner's passkey account and wallet). The house adversary is not on it: it is labelled as the team's in every count of outside demand, and eligible here so the definition is shown to pay where there is an edge.
